title: scale
content_html:
scale

In 10,000, the imagined act of magnifying a particle produces still more particles and eventually a mist. A work and a detail from it pose a related question about which relations survive a change of view. A detail may need a vocabulary quite different from the one that described the whole. Does something similar happen when an instant in a film is stretched out in time? 10,000 · Perception’s Sweet Spot of Scale

Reading note. Daoism. In “Autumn Floods,” the Zhuangzi moves from a river to the sea and to a frog whose world is a well. Each change of scale alters what can be taken in. What seems complete from one position, and what requires us to move or learn another way of describing it? Zhuangzi, 17
